title: Descending a local algebra essentially of finite presentation and a finitely presented module to the stages of a directed system of local rings
statement:
Let $(\Lambda,\le)$ be a nonempty directed set. Let $(A_\lambda,\mathfrak m_\lambda)_{\lambda\in\Lambda}$ be local rings with local homomorphisms $a_{\mu\lambda}:A_\lambda	o A_\mu$ for $\lambda\le\mu$ (a ring map $\varphi:(C,\mathfrak m_C)	o(D,\mathfrak m_D)$ of local rings is *local* if $\varphi(\mathfrak m_C)\subseteq\mathfrak m_D$), $a_{\lambda\lambda}=\mathrm{id}$, $a_{
u\mu}a_{\mu\lambda}=a_{
u\lambda}$; let $(A,\mathfrak m_A)$ be a local ring with local homomorphisms $\pi_\lambda:A_\lambda	o A$, $\pi_\mu a_{\mu\lambda}=\pi_\lambda$, such that $(A,(\pi_\lambda)_\lambda)$ is a colimit [def-weil-pbc-category-colimit] of $(A_\lambda,a_{\mu\lambda})$ in the category of commutative rings. Let $(T,\mathfrak m_T)$ be a local ring and $	au:A	o T$ a local homomorphism such that $T$ is essentially of finite presentation over $A$: $T$ is isomorphic, as an $A$-algebra, to a localization $W^{-1}P$ of a finitely presented $A$-algebra $P$ [def-weil-pbc-finitely-presented-algebra] at a multiplicative subset $W\subseteq P$. Let $N$ be a finitely presented $T$-module: $N\cong\operatorname{coker}(T^{\oplus s}	o T^{\oplus t})$ for some $s,t\ge0$ and some $T$-linear map. Then there exist $\lambda_0\in\Lambda$ and, with $\Lambda_0=\{\lambda\in\Lambda:\lambda\ge\lambda_0\}$ (a nonempty directed set), the following data: for $\lambda\in\Lambda_0$ a local ring $T_\lambda$, a local homomorphism $	au_\lambda:A_\lambda	o T_\lambda$ and a $T_\lambda$-module $N_\lambda$; for $\lambda\le\mu$ in $\Lambda_0$ local homomorphisms $t_{\mu\lambda}:T_\lambda	o T_\mu$ with $t_{\mu\lambda}	au_\lambda=	au_\mu a_{\mu\lambda}$ and additive maps $n_{\mu\lambda}:N_\lambda	o N_\mu$ with $n_{\mu\lambda}(yx)=t_{\mu\lambda}(y)\,n_{\mu\lambda}(x)$ ($y\in T_\lambda$, $x\in N_\lambda$), equal to the identity for $\lambda=\mu$ and compatible with composition; for $\lambda\in\Lambda_0$ local homomorphisms $\kappa_\lambda:T_\lambda	o T$ with $\kappa_\lambda	au_\lambda=	au\pi_\lambda$ and $\kappa_\mu t_{\mu\lambda}=\kappa_\lambda$, and additive maps $
u_\lambda:N_\lambda	o N$ with $
u_\lambda(yx)=\kappa_\lambda(y)
u_\lambda(x)$ and $
u_\mu n_{\mu\lambda}=
u_\lambda$; such that: (1) $(T,(\kappa_\lambda)_{\lambda\in\Lambda_0})$ is a colimit of $(T_\lambda,t_{\mu\lambda})_{\Lambda_0}$ in the category of commutative rings, and $(N,(
u_\lambda)_{\lambda\in\Lambda_0})$ is a colimit of $(N_\lambda,n_{\mu\lambda})_{\Lambda_0}$ in the category of abelian groups; (2) every $T_\lambda$ is essentially of finite type over $A_\lambda$ via $	au_\lambda$ [def-weil-pbc-essentially-finite-type-algebra]; (3) every $N_\lambda$ is the cokernel of a $T_\lambda$-linear map $T_\lambda^{\oplus s}	o T_\lambda^{\oplus t}$, in particular a finitely generated $T_\lambda$-module [def-weil-finitely-generated-module]; (4) for $\lambda\le\mu$ in $\Lambda_0$ the ring map $T_\lambda\otimes_{A_\lambda}A_\mu	o T_\mu$, $x\otimes y\mapsto t_{\mu\lambda}(x)	au_\mu(y)$, is a localization of $T_\lambda\otimes_{A_\lambda}A_\mu$ at some multiplicative subset (a ring map $C	o D$ is a *localization of $C$ at* a multiplicative subset $W\subseteq C$ if every element of $W$ maps to a unit of $D$, every element of $D$ is the image of $c$ times the inverse of the image of $w$ for some $c\in C$, $w\in W$, and $c\mapsto0$ implies $wc=0$ for some $w\in W$), and the map $N_\lambda\otimes_{T_\lambda}T_\mu	o N_\mu$, $x\otimes y\mapsto y\,n_{\mu\lambda}(x)$, is an isomorphism of $T_\mu$-modules; (5) for $\lambda\in\Lambda_0$ the ring map $T_\lambda\otimes_{A_\lambda}A	o T$, $x\otimes y\mapsto\kappa_\lambda(x)	au(y)$ ($A$ an $A_\lambda$-algebra via $\pi_\lambda$), is a localization of $T_\lambda\otimes_{A_\lambda}A$ at some multiplicative subset, and $N_\lambda\otimes_{T_\lambda}T	o N$, $x\otimes y\mapsto y\,
u_\lambda(x)$, is an isomorphism of $T$-modules.

source.place: Algebra, Lemma Tag 00QX (lemma-limit-module-essentially-finite-presentation, line 32427) and its proof ('We leave it to the reader to see that this works'), with the construction of the proof of Lemma Tag 00QV (lemma-limit-essentially-finite-presentation, line 32346): $T\cong(A[x_1,\dots,x_n]/(f_1,\dots,f_m))_{\mathfrak q}$, $f_j$ descended to $A_{\lambda}[x_1,\dots,x_n]$, $T_\lambda=(A_\lambda[x]/(f_{1,\lambda},\dots,f_{m,\lambda}))_{\mathfrak q_\lambda}$ with $\mathfrak q_\lambda$ the inverse image of $\mathfrak q$, and $N_\lambda=\operatorname{Coker}(A_\lambda\text{-matrix})$ for a matrix descending the presentation matrix of $N$. Here the system $(A_\lambda)$ is given, not constructed, which is the form in which the proof of Lemma Tag 00R7 (lemma-criterion-flatness-fibre, line 32992) uses the construction twice (for $R\to S$ over the $R_\lambda$, and for $S\to S'$ with $M$ over the $S_\lambda$). Clause (4) asks a localization at some multiplicative subset (00QX (5): at a prime ideal); clause (5) is the essentially-of-finite-presentation form of the 'in particular $M=M_\lambda\otimes_{S_\lambda}S$' of Lemma Tag 00R1 (lemma-limit-module-finite-presentation, line 32593).
